description: Find brands in the index by name (case and accents ignored, partial names work) or by a style word such as 'y2k' or 'quiet luxury', optionally within a category or catalog tier. Returns brands with item count, main tier, categories, price range and, with a key, trend status, trend score and top style tags. An empty query lists brands with the most items first.

anyOf.description: Optional self-identification. Identified callers help us rank better; keys make it reliable.

session_id.description: Your own opaque id linking calls in one shopping session. Never a user id.

limit.description: 1 to 20. Anonymous callers get at most 5.

query.description: Brand name or part of it ('loewe', 'acne'), or a style word ('y2k', 'gorpcore'). Empty lists every brand, most items first.

tier.description: Catalog tier, see the vocabulary tool.

name: search_brands
title: Search brands
